crossRefs.note: Behold, and answer me, Yahweh, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.
Vindicate me, Yahweh my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.
When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.
Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides; for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their…

translations.web: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
translations.bsb: For I said, “Let them not gloat over me— those who taunt me when my foot slips.”

translations.asv: For I said, Lest they rejoice over me: When my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.
